title: Story Scene Continuity
description: Four reference-dependent images follow the same child protagonist and fox companion through a warm storybook scene system.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the illustrated character pair, brush texture, page framing, and emotional tone. Images 02-04 preserve the same characters, palette family, and page-design language while moving through new scenes.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-bedtime-spread first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-raincoat-puddle-walk, 03-library-hideaway, 04-garden-evening-return. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-bedtime-spread is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
